scenes.heading: OPEN-SOURCE AI *CAUGHT UP*
scenes.sub: Kimi K3.1 · 6 channels covered it this week
scenes.say: Open source AI just caught up. Six channels covered this model this week. One hundred fifteen thousand views. This is Kimi K3.1, and it changes what free AI can do.

scenes.heading: Kimi K3.1
scenes.say: It's Kimi K3.1 from Moonshot AI. Not a closed model you pay per token for. It's open source. You can run it locally, deploy it yourself, or use it for free.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Kimi K3.1 passes the Rubik's Cube test, proving advanced spatial reasoning. It handles multi-step math, code generation, and complex problem solving. And it does it without an API key.

scenes.heading: 115,122 VIEWS THIS WEEK
scenes.say: One hundred fifteen thousand views this week. Six channels covering the same model means the AI community has noticed. Open source is no longer a compromise.

scenes.heading: RUN IT FREE
scenes.say: Download the model weights, run them on your hardware, or use a free inference provider. No signup, no billing, no per-token costs. Just open source.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: Kimi K3.1 is impressive, but it's not perfect. Some tasks still favor closed models. And running it locally needs decent hardware. But for the price, it's hard to beat.
